name: HDR-NeRF
aliases: High Dynamic Range Neural Radiance Fields
definition: An end-to-end neural rendering system that recovers a high dynamic range (HDR) radiance field from a set of low dynamic range (LDR) views with different exposures, enabling the generation of novel HDR views and novel LDR views under arbitrary exposures.
summary: HDR-NeRF is a high dynamic range view synthesis method that recovers an HDR radiance field from variable-exposure images, enabling novel HDR and LDR view generation without ghost artifacts.
